# MigrationError

- Namespace: `PPDS.Migration.Progress`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Migration`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Error information from a migration operation.
Contains RecordId (GUID) for correlation but no record data to avoid PII exposure.
